summary: Added count 80, flush toilets, water. Confirmed $20/$15, FCFS, year-round, showers, dump. Amperage and 60 ft not on the county's pages, left. Pin on the loop.
flags: Waterfront: 'lakeview' holds. The county says 'two campgrounds overlooking the lake', and imagery at 41.0772,-94.2143 shows the south-end pads ~70 m from the top of the bank and ~90 m from the waterline across an open meadow with few trees; west pads are 150 m+. Not on-water. The stored record is only 'assessed in commit 94f7ca6', and no campsite photo was read.
Lake level: county notice '(on 6/20/25) 10' low due to the lake renovation project'; imagery shows wide exposed banks. Dated, nothing newer found; not put in the note.

Two campgrounds, no split: imagery shows one continuous loop road plus a north arm by the cabins, no separate place ~1 km off or second entrance. The west end near 41.0785,-94.2185 is a gravel lot and spoil piles, no pads.
60 ft and 20/30/50 amp have no source on the county's pages (they came from the old note; only 'electrical hookups' is stated). Left per silence; unverified.
Sites contradiction: county says each of the 80 has electric and also posts a $15 non-electric rate.
Note's 'dump station in the south campground' unconfirmed: page says only 'dump station'; dropped with the rest of the field facts.
